rationale: The description explicitly states that the data management product family offers AI-empowered capabilities for managing structured and unstructured data.
ai_type_rationale: The text identifies data management as the core product and presents AI as capabilities offered by that conventional core, supporting ai_enabled without forcing the subtype.
evidence_spans: hybrid data management products offering a complete suite of AI-empowered capabilities designed to help you manage both structured and unstructured data

conflict_response: Both proposals support the AI binary label. The labeler marked ai_enabled as weak because the description does not explicitly say whether data management can operate without AI, while the blind proposal treated the conventional core as sufficient. The exact text directly calls the offering data management products and describes AI as capabilities for that function; it does not describe an AI-dependent core. This independently supports ai_enabled, so no forced subtype decision is needed.
